headline: Saudi Arabia Intercepts and Destroys Drone Near Holy City
summary: Saudi Arabia announced that a drone was intercepted and destroyed near Islam's holiest city.
why: Geopolitical security incidents and drone threats in the Middle East heighten regional risk premiums and can influence global energy market volatility.
